title: Mitrasamgraha: A Comprehensive Classical Sanskrit Machine Translation Dataset
reasoning: The paper presents a dataset and benchmark composed of historical Sanskrit literature, of which 'Religious Scriptures' and 'Treatises' (philosophical/religious commentaries) make up approximately 37% of the total corpus. The benchmarking process specifically evaluates model performance on translating these spiritually and philosophically significant texts, including the Vedas, Puranas, and Buddhist scriptures.
